subject: Logic
title: Building a Truth Table
description: A micro-lesson that makes Building a Truth Table usable.

hook.text: How do you prove a logical formula works for every possible input? List them all in a table.

buildup.text: A truth table lists every combination of true/false for each variable, then evaluates the whole formula.

discovery.text: Two variables make four rows. Three make eight. Each new variable doubles the rows: 2^n combinations.

twist.text: Truth tables are brute-force but foolproof. If the formula holds in every row, it's a tautology.

climax.text: They're the simplest proof method in logic—no creativity needed, just careful bookkeeping.

quiz.question: How many rows does a truth table with 3 variables have?
